channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The clearest win this period is the U.S. DOE's $489 million loan closing with Pattern Energy to build 220MW of battery storage in Arecibo and Santa Isabel, aimed at lowering electricity costs and strengthening grid reliability. Liberty PR reported improved Q2 earnings and two foundations committed $536,500 to medical-workforce scholarships, both modest positive signals. The dominant risk is Puerto Rico's severe drought and water-rationing crisis, now hitting 180,000-500,000+ customer accounts across San Juan and surrounding municipalities, with early measurable damage to tourism and agriculture businesses — reliable water service is a baseline site-selection criterion, so this is a real reputational exposure. Otherwise a quiet week for new FDI or expansion announcements, with coverage dominated by infrastructure-reliability concerns rather than fresh deals.
